context.problem_statement: Compare measurement values between two experimental groups (Control vs Treatment) using a two-sample independent t-test. Steps: (1) check assumptions: test for normality using Shapiro-Wilk test for each group, test for equal variances using Levene's test, (2) run the appropriate t-test (equal or unequal variance based on Levene's result), (3) report t-statistic, degrees of freedom, p-value, and 95% confidence interval for the mean difference, (4) compute Cohen's d effect size = (mean1 - mean2) / pooled_std, (5) compute statistical power using scipy.stats.power (post-hoc power analysis at alpha=0.05).
context.expert_knowledge: scipy.stats.ttest_ind(a, b, equal_var=True/False). Cohen's d: small=0.2, medium=0.5, large=0.8. Pooled std = sqrt(((n1-1)*s1^2 + (n2-1)*s2^2) / (n1+n2-2)). Power analysis: statsmodels.stats.power.TTestIndPower().solve_power(). Welch's t-test (equal_var=False) is robust to unequal variances. CI for difference: (mean_diff ± t_crit * SE_diff).
